step3.ptxt: The intelligent parking assist system uses CAN communication for data communication between the television camera controller and each ECU.

If there is a problem in the CAN communication line, the television camera controller outputs a CAN communication malfunction DTC. (Check using the TaSCAN diagnostic tool screen and the diagnosis screen of the navigation receiver assembly) (For the procedure, refer to and )

If a CAN communication malfunction code is output, repair the communication line malfunction, and troubleshoot the intelligent parking assist system with data communication in a normal condition. (see )
Each CAN communication line has a specified length and routing, and temporary measures or repairs using bypass wiring, etc. cannot be performed. (see )
The intelligent parking assist system uses AVC - LAN for communication between components.
The master component of the AVC - LAN is the navigation receiver assembly.
The navigation receiver assembly contains a resistor necessary for communication transmission (60 to 80 Ω between terminals TX+ and TX-).

If a malfunction such as a short in the communication line, short to +B or short to GND occurs in the AVC - LAN circuit, communication is interrupted, and the intelligent parking assist system and HDD navigation system do not operate normally.

step3.ptxt: Using the diagnosis function of the HDD navigation system, the intelligent parking assist system can perform connection checks and diagnosis (reading and clearing of AVC - LAN diagnostic trouble codes is possible) for the components connected via AVC - LAN. (Inspection results are displayed on the multi-display)
Each component that makes up the AVC - LAN is assigned a 3-digit number (expressed in base 16) called a component code (physical address).
Each function (unit) within an AVC - LAN component is assigned a 2-digit number (expressed in base 16) called a logical address.
The intelligent parking assist system has a diagnosis function that allows registration settings, adjustment and checks of the intelligent parking assist system.
By connecting the TaSCAN diagnostic tool, the intelligent parking assist system can be checked for the items shown in the table below.
